title: host_only privacy mode: confine Susi to this machine alone
goal: Add a fourth privacy mode, host_only (aliases host-only, host), the strictest posture: everything local_only blocks plus every non-loopback target. One root reach check (url_stays_on_host: 127.0.0.0/8, ::1, IPv4-mapped loopback, localhost) behind every egress gate, with no grant reopening egress or cloud inference and consent refused; peer calls to any non-loopback address refused before a connection opens, attested members included; the UDP discovery responder answers no off-host datagram (loopback readiness pings still answered) and the scout sends and reads none; gossip re-bound to loopback live on a mode switch and sending nothing off-host; the GMCP, GMCP alias, GEMI and A2A listeners drop off-host clients whatever bind_address says; STUN discovery off. Every gate reads the sticky mode per operation, so a switch applies to a running daemon without a restart. CLI help, GMCP tool descriptions and schema, daemon tool registration, architecture and threat-model docs state what host_only guarantees and its limits. balanced stays the default; local_only is unchanged.
acceptance: cargo test -p susi --test host_only_privacy --offline --locked passes: under host_only a peer call to a routed non-loopback IPv4 of this host is refused naming host-only mode before any connection (attested member or not) while a loopback peer is reached and local_only reaches the same listener; a real daemon bound to 0.0.0.0 with remote plaintext allowed answers no signed discovery ping and serves no HTTP client from that address on any of its four TCP listeners while loopback pings and clients are served, and `susi privacy mode local_only` on the running daemon restores both, `host_only` closes them again.
